CVE-2019-0604.d: Microsoft SharePoint fails to check the source markup of an application package. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run remote code in the context of the SharePoint application pool and the SharePoint server farm account.

CVE-2019-0541.n: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2019-0541.d: Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

CVE-2019-0211.n: Apache HTTP Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
CVE-2019-0211.d: Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.
